title: Your broke friend can copy money. There's a catch.
idea: There's a catch, episode 4: the friend who never has money can copy it: one coin, a hundred wallets, every dollar in the city; then prices explode and he burns his money to keep warm

hook.what: Gunslinger shows his empty wallet and his one coin, the moth flying out; the counter man's palm is out; Reaper reaches for his own wallet. The narrator: 'Your broke friend can copy money. There's a catch.'
